name: Ruche mécanisée
prompt: Create ONE complete ALL-MECHANICAL Metal Gear inspired walking machine for an original CQC costume of THE PAIN, titled Ruche mecanisee. Use only the character-related mustard-yellow/graphite palette, broad heavy mass, hexagonal hive armor, reservoir motif and amber optics from the references as visual codes. The reference image contains multiple earlier concepts: use the MIDDLE ALL-ROBOT hive machine for machine construction inspiration, and do not reproduce any human figure. This new v2 corrects the human-worn exoskeleton design: absolutely NO human head, no balaclava, no skin, no hair, no hands, no human boots, no clothing, no operator visible. Build a genuinely nonhumanoid quadrupedal heavy hive-platform: broad low armored central reactor hull with interlocking yellow hexagonal plates; a compact faceted sensor turret with a horizontal amber optical slit mounted on a real slewing ring; four powerful hydraulic articulated legs with steel pivots and wide three-toed mechanical ground pads; short rigid utility manipulator built into the front hull; two upper rear cylindrical pressure reservoirs with routed metal tubing; paired recessed honeycomb mechanical-drone docking bays, all drone shapes mechanically stowed flush in those bays. Convincing joints and weight-bearing construction; all four leg roots attach to hull, piston ends anchored, no detached floating parts. Distinct coherent headless industrial machine, no human-shaped face, no insect animals. SINGLE neutral-ready static side/three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT, all four ground pads planted in correct perspective. Entire machine including rear hardware fits inside the canvas with 5 percent transparent border. Detailed hand-painted hard-surface 2D/2.5D fighting-game machine sprite, crisp outlines and material shading matching this project. Truly TRANSPARENT background, no floor, no cast shadow, no atmospheric haze, no comparison sheet, no atlas, no repeated views, no text or UI. This is an original CQC machine design, not an official Konami machine and not an exact reconstruction of lost historical PNG bytes.
